journey.name: BBoard: on-chain happy path
journey.description:
Every contract call bboard can submit: deploy a board, post a message, take it down. bboard.compact exports three circuits — `post`, `takeDown` and `publicKey` — and the third is a view circuit the app reads rather than sends.
The pair matters more than either half. A board that can be posted to but not taken down is broken in a way a post-only run reports as healthy, and take-down is the only call that depends on the poster's own secret key matching what the board recorded.
Expect a transport failure. PreProd's indexer socket drops roughly every forty seconds under load, and unlike the dust sync the contract-call path does not resume through one: a drop surfaces as a generic failure with a RETRY control, and the retry succeeds. Both take-downs in the verifying run needed exactly that. A journey that does not expect it will report a working app as broken.
Preconditions this journey does NOT set up, and fails honestly without: - a debuggable build whose local.properties sets kuira.dev.seed, so there is a wallet without a passkey ceremony, and kuira.blockfrost.projectId, so PreProd answers at all; - that wallet funded on PreProd, with dust registered; - the post and takeDown proving keys installed.
Verified end to end on PreProd 2026-10-24: deploy proved its dust fee in 1.22s and landed the board, post submitted in 23.3s and read back from chain, take-down submitted and the board returned to vacant.

actions.action: If a notification permission prompt is shown, decline it
If a "Keep your wallet synced" backup offer is shown, choose "Not now"
Verify the screen does NOT show "identity required"
Verify the screen shows a "create a new board" control
Verify the screen does NOT show "Deploy failed"
Enter a message into the "your message" field
If the screen shows a "RETRY" control, tap it — a dropped socket is expected here
Verify the screen shows the message that was entered
If the screen shows a "RETRY" control, tap it — a dropped socket is expected here
Verify the screen shows "board is vacant"
Verify the screen does NOT show "POSTED"
